programme.title: ¡VA POR USTEDES! 16
programme.desc: Toros | +16 · En nuestro próximo viaje taurino, ¡prepárate para embarcarte en un recorrido lleno de emociones y descubrimientos! Partiremos hacia Guillena, donde la maestría de Irene Tirado en la ganadería "Virgen María" nos sumergirá en un mundo de tradición y nobleza. En su hotel, cada rincón respira el espíritu del campo, ofreciendo una experiencia única donde los toros son los protagonistas. Viajaremos hacia Arganda del Rey, donde nos adentraremos en el mundo de la taxidermia junto a Luis Maroto, un artista que da vida a la belleza de la naturaleza en su taller. Desde sus manos, veremos renacer la majestuosidad de la fauna salvaje. Mas tarde, nos dirigiremos a Villaluenga del Rosario, donde en su histórica plaza de toros, el objetivo de Emilio Barea nos transportará a través del tiempo. Sus imágenes capturan la esencia misma de la fiesta brava, revelando la pasión y el arte que rodea cada festejo popular. Finalmente, nos detendremos en Albacete, donde Juan Andrés Barbero moldea el tiempo y la historia en el filo de sus cuchillos. Con el asta de toro como lienzo, sus creaciones son verdaderas obras de arte, fusionando la destreza del artesano con la bravura del toro. ¡Prepárate para vivir una jornada llena de aventuras, donde cada encuentro será un nuevo capítulo en la apasionante historia de la tauromaquia! ¡Va por ustedes.

programme.title: Episode 1: Defend & Attack - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · The season begins, and a new king reigns. But on the brutal icy roads of the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo, legends and rivals are closing in. WRC More than Machine Season 2 is here!

programme.title: Episode 2: Now or Never - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · It's Now or Never! Rally Sweden’s icy roads and Safari Rally Kenya’s wild terrain push drivers to their limits. Rivals clash, teams strategise, and every second counts. Episode 2 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 3: Vanishing Point - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · Toyota dominates early rallies, Hyundai fights for glory, and Neuville seeks redemption. Ogier's part-time run heats up the battle. Can the Manufacturers' Championship finally shift? EP3 now streaming!

programme.title: Episode 4: Resilience - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · With the new kid on the block Martins Sesks showing impressive pace, Adrien and Gregoire begin to feel the pressure as this rising star pushes them to the limits. In this episode of More than Machine, the talented 24-year-old and his teammates at M-Sport take on some of the most challenging stages of the season – Poland and Latvia.

programme.title: Episode 5: Cause and Effect - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · As M-Sport races towards the end of the season in Finland and Greece, tensions start to turn to securing drivers for next year. In episode five of More Than Machine, Adrien Fourmaux considers what it will take to be a world champion—and with which team.

programme.title: Episode 6: Let the Games Begin - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · With sights set on 2025, the M-Sport team tests their potential drivers for the upcoming season, determined to find their next leading contender. In episode six of More than Machine, step behind the scenes to see how M-Sport's young drivers strive to prove themselves at the crunch point of the season.

programme.title: Episode 7: Fortune Favours the Brave - More Than Machine S2
programme.desc: Sports · With everything on the line, bold risks and fearless moves will give you the crown. The moment where legends are forged and history is made. Don’t miss the epic conclusion of More Than Machine S2!

programme.title: Full Event Highlights - Rallye Monte-Carlo 2026
programme.desc: Sports · What a start to the new season. Rallye Monte-Carlo 2026 proved again why this event is one of the toughest tests in the WRC calendar. Don't miss the highlight show from Round 1.
